input.free_text_description: This system is an e-commerce platform that serves User, Candidate roles. It manages core business objects including order, product, score, user. The platform provides capabilities for order, product, tcc score. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include user management functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a User, I want to create and manage order records, so that I can track and organize order data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage product records, so that I can track and organize product data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage score records, so that I can track and organize score data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage user records, so that I can track and organize user data effectively.
